title: Review of c03's FCH protocell vesicles (SIBW): replicates on seed 21; the barrier is the only arm with contrast across the wall (lumen/wall 30-80x vs ~1 in a 100x-slower twin)
summary: Fresh seed 21 labkit re-run (T=1600): five bilayer vesicles nucleate from white noise by t~64 (one multilamellar onion), and four keep a solute-filled lumen to the end; lumen/outside 23-33x up to t~740, decaying to 7.8x by t=1600 as the outside fills. Two vesicles fuse at t~630 and their two lumens merge by t~1250. chi=0 on the same seed: lumen/outside 1.7 -> 1.0. A lowered-D twin (chi=0, Dc/100) still reaches lumen/outside 10-20x, because the wall-made solute barely moves, but its lumen is no richer than its wall (lumen/wall 0.4-1.06), while the world's lumen holds 30-80x its own wall. So the 2x lumen/outside test alone is passed by slow diffusion, but containment across the boundary is not.

observations.S: rerun/seed21/sheet.png t=0: white noise over the whole domain; five vesicles by t=64
observations.I: rerun/seed21/sheet.png t=64-1600: four discrete vesicles persist at fixed positions and size to the end; FACTS 5 persistent tracks
observations.B: rerun/seed21/FACTS.md radial: amphiphile u rim/core 1.91, rim/outside 42.8, 24/32 membrane-like; the bilayer ring around a gold lumen is visible in every frame of sheet.png
observations.W: lumen_wall_seed21.txt: lumen/outside 23-33x to t~740 and >= 7.8x to t=1600, lumen/wall 30-80x; chi=0: 1.0-1.7x

controls_run.B: rerun_chi0/seed21/sheet.png: the bilayer rings are unchanged without the barrier, the lumen is no longer distinct

verdicts.limitation: A barrier-free solute 100x slower also scores lumen/outside >= 2x (10-20x), so that metric alone is not a containment test; the barrier shows only as contrast across the wall (lumen/wall 30-80x vs ~1). Lumen contrast decays over the run (33x -> 7.8x by t=1600) as the outside fills (kd=0.001). The solute is passive, one nucleus becomes a multilamellar onion, a fusion merges two lumens, and nothing moves or divides.
